author: Linnaeus, 1761
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수만 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 해안 근처의 호수, 하구, 석호, 만
summary: 곳에 따라 흔한 겨울철새로, 겨울철 전국의 하구와 석호, 만에서 관찰된다. 해안 가까운 호수나 하구에서 무리를 지어 지내며, 잠수해 조개류, 갑각류, 해초류를 먹는다. 유라시아 대륙 북부와 북아메리카 북부에서 번식하고, 유럽, 카스피해, 페르시아만, 우수리, 중국 동부, 한국, 일본, 북아메리카 서부·동부 해안에서 월동한다.

art.subject: Greater Scaup (Aythya marila), adult male in winter, as seen in Korean bays and estuaries from November to March: head and neck black with a green gloss, the head smoothly rounded with no tuft; breast black; back pale grey, finely vermiculated with black wavy lines; flanks white; tail end black. Bill pale blue-grey with a small black nail at the tip; bright yellow eye; grey legs.
art.pose: swimming in a flock on open water, about to dive
art.scene: Korean winter coastal lagoon with calm open water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: rounded green-glossed black head with no tuft, black breast, pale grey finely vermiculated back, white flanks, black tail end, blue-grey bill with a small black tip, yellow eye
adult female, side view swimming: dark brown head, broad white patch around the base of the bill, brown breast, grey-brown body, blue-grey bill, yellow eye, no tuft
art.build: Bulky diving duck, about 45cm, smaller than a Mallard but heavy-bodied and broad-backed, sitting low on the water. Large, smoothly rounded head with no crest. Bill broad and flattened, a little shorter than the head. Legs short, grey, set far back. Dives for shellfish in flocks. In flight a broad white wing-bar runs along the secondaries and inner primaries.
avoid: Do not add a drooping tuft at the back of the head — that is Tufted Duck (Aythya fuligula).
Do not paint a black back; the scaup's back is pale grey with fine black vermiculations.
Do not paint a broad black bill tip; only the small nail is black.
Do not paint a dark eye; adults have bright yellow eyes.
